addr: First Floor, Public Utility Building, 19, Mahatma Gandhi Rd, Shanthala Nagar, Ashok Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560001, India

rev.t: Came across Urban Diva while exploring MG Road area. The ladies clothing collection is varied and the fabric quality is better than what you'd expect at this price point. Genuinely impressed.
Good ethnic wear options near MG Road. Picked up a co-ord set last weekend, stitching is solid and the price didn't hurt. Decent spot for Bangalore shoppers.
The staff let me browse without hovering, which I appreciated. Bought a printed kurta set. Comfortable fabric, reasonable pricing. Worth a visit if you're around MG Road.
